Welcome to TETRIS®, the official mobile app for the world’s favorite puzzle game. Play through hundreds of unique TETRIS Levels in a new Tetris experience. Play a quick round to beat your own score, or play infinite rounds to master your skills in the TETRIS Single Player Modes. TETRIS forever!

Enjoy the ultimate block puzzle game with these amazing features:

PLAY HUNDREDS OF TETRIS LEVELS 
• Puzzle your way through challenging but fun objectives by playing Tetris.
• The classic Tetris game with a twist!
• Improve your gameplay by learning new tricks and master the hardest levels!
• Play Tetris like never before! Clear lines and solve level puzzles.

TETRIS SINGLE PLAYER 
• Master your skills with the iconic Tetris gameplay you know and love.
* Pick between the Marathon mode for endless rounds or the new Quick Play Mode for when you want to play Tetris but only have a few minutes to play.
• Rotate Tetriminos, clear lines and crush your high score.
• Available offline - enjoy Tetris anytime, anywhere.

PUZZLE YOUR WAY
• Complete Daily Challenges in your favorite modes to earn XP and rewards.
• Enjoy intuitive touch controls or choose on-screen controls.
• Personalize your game experience and Player Profile with custom themes, backgrounds, avatars and avatar frames.
• Show off your Tetris style in case you’re featured in in-game videos.


The world’s favorite block puzzle game is now a game for everyone to play anytime, anywhere. Tetris forever!

Do you crave adorable cat-themed entertainment paired with toe-tapping music games? Your quest ends here with Rhythm Cats! 
Join these lovable kitties in a symphony of "Cat Music" that combines catchy pop tunes with delightful "meowing" sounds. Immerse yourself in a world of rhythm and melody, where each beat harmonizes with your every move. Explore a vast song selection, including chart-toppers from around the globe and your favorite indie tracks.
Key Features:
An extensive collection of sizzling hot tracks to select from
Remixes of hit songs enhanced with charming "meows"
Simple and intuitive guides to keep you on track
Effortless one-touch controls for a seamless gaming experience
Vibrant colors and captivating designs to keep your eyes entertained
A diverse array of kawaii cats eagerly awaiting your collection
How to Play:
Hold and drag your cat to gracefully leap onto the correct tiles
Keep your rhythm sharp and never miss a tile throughout each song!
Aim to conquer as many songs as you can!
Accumulate gold to unlock new and endearing cats
For an immersive musical journey, we recommend using headphones
Prepare for a symphony of surprises! Download now and embrace an entirely new experience of rhythm and cuteness.
